# Bhawani Technologies — Delhi NCR's #1 Waterproofing Company

> Professional waterproofing contractor and construction chemical applicator serving Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad since 2015.

## About
Bhawani Technologies is a Delhi NCR-based waterproofing company with 10+ years of experience and 500+ completed projects. We specialize in the supply and professional application of high-performance waterproofing systems for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Our trained applicators are certified by Dr. Fixit (Pidilite), Asian Paints, Fosroc, and Sika India.

## Core Services

### Roof Waterproofing
- APP Modified Bitumen Torch-on Membranes (3mm & 4mm, SBS/APP polymer)
- Polyurethane (PU) Liquid Applied Membrane (seamless monolithic coating)
- Elastomeric Cool Roof Acrylic Coating (solar reflective, heat-proof)
- EPDM Single-Ply Rubber Membrane (commercial & green roofs)
- Crystalline Integral Waterproofing (permanent concrete protection)
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/roof-waterproofing

### Terrace Waterproofing
- Crack filling & polymer-modified mortar repair
- Tile terrace waterproofing without demolition
- Brick bat coba rehabilitation
- Cool roof + waterproof combined systems
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/terrace-waterproofing

### Basement Waterproofing
- PU Injection Grouting for active water leakage
- Crystalline concrete waterproofing
- Drainage & sump pump systems
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/basement-waterproofing

### Bathroom Waterproofing
- Under-tile flexible membrane application
- Epoxy tile joint grouting
- Pipe penetration sealing
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/bathroom-waterproofing

### Water Tank Waterproofing
- Food-grade non-toxic cementitious lining
- Epoxy coating for potable water tanks
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/water-tank-waterproofing

### Epoxy Flooring
- Self-leveling epoxy flooring
- Anti-static ESD flooring
- Industrial polyurethane coatings
- Service page: https://www.bhawanitechnologies.in/services/epoxy-flooring

## Approved Material Partners
- **Dr. Fixit (Pidilite):** Roofseal, Roofseal Classic, Pidifin 2K, 301 Pidicrete URP, 302 Super Latex, Newcoat
- **Asian Paints SmartCare:** Damp Proof, Damp Proof Ultra, Hydroloc
- **Fosroc Chemicals:** Brushbond RFX, Nitoproof, Conbextra
- **Sika India:** SikaTop Seal 107, SikaBit T-140 SG
- **STP Chemicals:** Industrial-grade PU membranes

## Service Areas
Delhi (all zones), Noida, Greater Noida, Gurugram (Gurgaon), Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and surrounding NCR regions.
